summary: SchemeSpec dataclass describing a canonical URL scheme (prefix, provider, examples). SCHEMES dict maps scheme strings to SchemeSpec instances. Covers s3://, gs://, az://, sftp://, ftp://, smb://, file://, http://, https://, and bare paths.
extension_points: Add new SchemeSpec entries to SCHEMES dict to support additional URL schemes
documentation_hooks: Extension authors need SCHEMES to register new URL schemes; users do not need it directly

evidence.detail: Tests scheme lookup and SCHEMES dict
